hsp029.name: HSP-029
hsp029.summary: Cut NEAR's maximum annual issuance from 2.5% to 1.6%, phased in over 24 months after a 90-day buffer.
hsp029.status: Approved by House of Stake vote (closed 2026-11-02, 99.97% of participating voting power in favour). Not in effect: needs ratification and a validator-adopted protocol upgrade. Live protocol config still reads 2.5% (evidence/protocol.json).
hsp029.use: Scenario only: issuance scaled by max_inflation / current max_inflation (the end state after the phase-in).
